newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech selects agency for Hispanic ads.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech selects agency for Hispanic ads.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said on Monday it selected the Chicago-based advertising agency Hernandez and Garcia to handle its print and broadcast Hispanic advertising campaigns.
The agency will assume creative and media buying responsibilities previously handled by Castor Inc of New York, Ameritech said.
An Ameritech spokesman declined to disclose the annual billings for the company's Hispanic advertising campaigns.

Ameritech is a communications services provider which despite its origins as a Midwest regional Baby Bell now provides communications services to millions of customers in 50 states and 40 countries worldwide, including local and long distance telephone, cellular, paging and security services.
Its shares closed off 1 Monday at 57-1/8.
